description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Repeat.

uses.name: Weaver of Blossoms // Blossom-Clad Werewolf
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Blossom-Clad Werewolf and without summoning sickness
